mcp_server/whatsapp-mcp.tagline: Send, receive, and search WhatsApp from Claude
mcp_server/whatsapp-mcp.overview: WhatsApp MCP connects Claude to WhatsApp so you can send and receive messages from chat. It includes tools to search your conversations and manage contacts. It is useful for handling WhatsApp without switching apps.

mcp_server/filesystem.tagline: Let your assistant read and write local files
mcp_server/filesystem.overview: Filesystem is an official reference MCP server that gives an AI assistant controlled access to your local files. It can read, write, search, and manage files, but only inside directories you explicitly allow, which keeps it sandboxed. This is the standard way to let an assistant work directly with files on your machine.
capabilities: Reads and writes files within allowed directories
Lists directories and searches for files
Creates, moves, and deletes files and folders
Restricts all access to the directories you whitelist
useCases: Letting an assistant edit code or notes in a specific project folder
Organizing or batch-renaming files through natural language
Reading reference documents from a chosen directory
howTo: Add the filesystem server to your MCP client config
Pass the allowed directory paths as arguments after the package name
Run with npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /path/to/allowed/dir
Restart your client so it picks up the server
Ask the assistant to list or edit files in that directory
goodToKnow: Only the directories you pass are accessible; choose them narrowly for safety.
Giving write access means the assistant can change or delete files, so scope it carefully.

mcp_server/browserbase.tagline: Drive cloud browsers for AI web automation
mcp_server/browserbase.overview: Browserbase MCP drives cloud browsers to automate web tasks and run AI-driven browsing workflows. Because the browsers run in the cloud, you can automate the web without managing a local browser setup. It suits people building agents that need to navigate websites.

Developers building agents that browse and act on websites

Set up the server from github.com/browserbase/mcp-server-browserbase

Ask the agent to automate a web task in a cloud browser

example.code: Open example.com in a cloud browser and extract the main heading

goodToKnow: Requires a Browserbase account and credentials.
Cloud browsing may involve usage costs depending on your plan.

mcp_server/youtube-downloader.tagline: Download YouTube videos or audio with yt-dlp
mcp_server/youtube-downloader.overview: YouTube Downloader MCP downloads YouTube videos or converts them to MP3 or MP4 using yt-dlp. It is useful for analyzing content offline once you have it saved locally. You ask for a video and it handles the download or conversion.
capabilities: Convert videos to MP3 or MP4

Anyone converting YouTube content to MP3 or MP4 for analysis

Register it with your MCP client

Ask it to download or convert the video
goodToKnow: Respect YouTube's terms and copyright when downloading content.
Relies on yt-dlp, which may need to be available on your system.

mcp_server/ntfy-push-notifications.tagline: Get push alerts when your tasks finish
mcp_server/ntfy-push-notifications.overview: This server sends custom push notifications through the ntfy service. You can wire it up so your AI assistant pings your phone or desktop when a long-running task is done, instead of you having to keep checking.
capabilities: Works inside your AI assistant's workflow

mcp_server/puppeteer-vision-web-scraper.tagline: Scrape pages past captchas and banners
mcp_server/puppeteer-vision-web-scraper.overview: This server uses Puppeteer to scrape websites and pull out their content. It is built to handle common roadblocks like CAPTCHAs, cookie banners, and paywalls so you can extract the text you need from tricky pages.

mcp_server/stack-overflow.tagline: Search Stack Overflow from inside your AI client

mcp_server/iterm.tagline: Run shell commands in your iTerm tab via AI
mcp_server/iterm.overview: This MCP server runs shell commands directly in your active iTerm tab. It lets your AI assistant automate terminal workflows on a Mac.
